codegraph.note: Local CodeGraph MCP server for repository structure, call-flow tracing, symbol search, and impact analysis. Project indexes live in each repository's .codegraph/ directory. In the Codex adapter, when a selfL plugin or skill is explicitly invoked inside a Git repository, follow shared-rules/codegraph.md and bootstrap the current repository if needed; otherwise ask before running `npx -y @colbymchenry/codegraph init -i`.
